name: Lars
title: Subterra
subtitle: Zero bars. All bass.
conceptLead: A weekend festival for city students who think nature is boring and far away.

concept.text: You walk through the Ardennes to a campsite, sleep under the trees and party deep inside the Caves of Han, where your phone loses its signal all by itself. You go home with a map called "Now go touch some grass", full of hidden nature spots for your next trip.

facts.title: The cause
facts.text: City students live almost only inside the city and spend little to no time in nature.
facts.quote: How might we turn a night out into a first step into nature for city students in Brussels?

facts.title: The goal
facts.text: After our festival, Dirk is excited about nature and plans his first trip with his friends.

facts.title: The USP
facts.text: Unlike regular festivals, which keep you in the city, Subterra turns the party itself into the first step into nature.

persona.name: Dirk
persona.line: 19, psychology student, lives in a student room in Brussels

parts.label: Goal
parts.text: Switch off from studying and do something real with his friends.

parts.label: Pain point
parts.text: Nature feels boring and far away. He has no car, no idea where to go, and his friends don't go either.

persona.insight: Dirk wants to go out into nature, but he does not know how to survive and camp in the wild.

journey.text: Studies, scrolls, stays in the city.
Takes the train, hikes to camp, parties in the cave.
Unfolds his map of hidden spots and plans a trip.

touchpoints: Instagram ads, posters in schools, other social media

logLead: One entry per session, newest first.

log.title: Three visual directions
log.text: Made a moodboard and a first mark for three directions: Topo, Zero bars and Campfire. These are my first sketches. The finished marks are in the directions section above.

log.title: Concept brief (D-1)
log.text: Finished the concept brief for Subterra: cause, persona and journey, positioning, concept statement, tagline and tone of voice.

log.title: What's the big idea?
log.text: Clustered ideas, wrote the goal and the USP, and brainstormed names and taglines. Chose the name Subterra and the tagline "Zero bars. All bass." "Touch some grass" became the name of the take-home map.

log.title: Who is it for?
log.text: Wrote my cause card (colour: green), made my persona Dirk and filled in his empathy map.

log.title: Starting ideas
log.text: Came up with two festival ideas, a cave festival and a gambling festival, and chose the cave festival.
